w.8: whom … does … apply the halakhot … conspiring

p: “And you shall do to him as he conspired”
“to him,” but not to his offspring. … Let … invalidate … and not invalidate his offspring.
“to him,” but not to his offspring. Rendering the witness a ḥalal would disqualify his offspring as well. The Gemara challenges: Let the court invalidate the witness and not invalidate his offspring.
